body.statement: Conditional on a proof of \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}frontier}\) and hence on a proved uniform cutoff \(B_2(n)\), let \(G\) be any acyclic indegree-two mixed graph on \(n\) vertices. One exact call to \(DBI\) at degree \(B_2(n)\) terminates and returns yes with minimum-degree rational formulas if and only if \(G\in\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\). Its arithmetic complexity is \[O\!\left(B_2(n)n^5\{3B_2(n)n\}^{4\alpha_{\mathrm{alg}}B_2(n)^2\log(3B_2(n)n)}\right),\] and a no answer is accompanied by a complete exact bounded-search certificate rather than a timeout status. No unconditional total schedule is asserted before the frontier is proved.
body.justification: Once established, the frontier converts a promise search into a total formula-producing decision procedure on the stated class.
body.gap: Dörfler et al. give a total polynomial-space generic-identification decision without formulas, while Hollering, Misra, and Sturma return formulas only relative to a supplied cutoff.
body.consumer: Users of DegBoundedIdentifiability obtain an auditable stopping rule and an explicit worst-case resource bound for indegree-two graphs.
